topic: Donald Dutton & Arthur Aron (1974) Capilano Suspension Bridge Misattribution of Arousal (50% vs 12.5% Call Rate), Schachter-Singer Two-Factor Mechanism (Amygdala/Insula vs Prefrontal Label), and Post-Crossing Control (Low-Poly Pastel v7)
act5_climax_episode: Dutton and Aron's Study 2 post-crossing 10-minute rest control and Study 3 laboratory electric-shock replication proving that physiological arousal only amplifies attraction when paired with an immediate salient target before the pulse subsides.
